behavioral_signatures: Execution of subprocesses from utility or data formatting functions
Decryption and execution of embedded or remote code at runtime
Background threads launched on import in libraries
Endless polling of remote C2 servers for executable payloads
Exfiltration of host environment data (OS, MAC, working directory) to external servers
file_indicators: Presence of edt/bounding.py or similar hidden modules
Obfuscated or hex-encoded strings in code
Modifications to __init__.py to launch threads
Suspicious function names (e.g., startingbound, prepend_scheme_if_neede)
network_indicators: Connections to tableditermanaging.pro
Connections to packages-api.test
Connections to 45.61.136.133
HTTP POSTs with host profiling data
Polling for .jpg or other non-standard payloads from C2
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Python packages that spawn subprocesses or execute code from obfuscated strings, especially in utility functions. Flag packages that collect and exfiltrate host data or poll remote servers for executable payloads. Use static analysis to detect XOR/hex/Base64 decryption routines and dynamic analysis to catch delayed or multi-stage execution. Watch for network connections to known C2 domains/IPs and unusual HTTP POSTs from development environments. Correlate presence of hidden modules and suspicious function names with behavioral indicators for high-confidence detection.
